paragraphs: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Forest (Amendment) Regulations, 2021 and shall be read as one with the Forest Regulations, 2004 hereinafter referred to as the "principal Regulations".
2. The principal Regulations are amended in the Eighth Schedule by adding immediately after item "H" the following:
Entry fees per research per year
Type of research | East African Citizens/Nationals (Tsh) per research | Residents Non East African Citizens/National (USD or equivalent) per research | Non Residents (USD or equivalent) per research
3. The principal Regulations are amended in the Fourteenth Schedule by-
Ornamental plants and flowers per kg or part thereof | 1000.00
Quantity license for fibers and Raffia (Umondo, Ukindu and grasses) per kg or part thereof | 200.00
(b) deleting the "Note" under Part "B" and substituting for it the following:

Note: Where the mode of disposal is by tender or public auction, the fees set below shall be the baseline price; but in the event the mode of disposal is by public auction, the auction price shall apply to all persons who have valid sale agreements with the government.
(c) deleting "ITEM 1B" and substituting for it the following;
Logging residues from plantations per stacked cubic meter | 10,000.00
Logging residues from natural forest per stacked cubic meter | 50,000.00
Logging residues from Teak plantations per cubic meter | 100,000.00
Cuttings from mangrove forest per piece | 6,000.00
(d) deleting the first row of item 2 and substituting for it the following;
Fees for pine and eucalyptus pulpwood trees for paper production shall be charged per cubic metre and shall not be used for any purpose other than pulp production. | 27,885.00
Fees for eucalyptus pulpwood for manufacturing of fibreboard shall be charged per cubic meter and shall not be used for any purpose other than fibreboard pulp production. | 21,450.00
(e) deleting paragraphs (xvii), (xviii), (xxi), (xxii), (xxiii) and (xxvii) of ITEM 1 appearing in Part C and substituting for them the following;
(xvii)  | Establishment fees of mineral extraction plant (Except building minerals) based on area of operation per ha or part thereof | 11,800,000.00
(xviii) | Forest management fees for conducting mining activities (Except building minerals) in a forest reserve based on area of operation per year per ha or part of | 1,500,000.00
(xxi) | Installation/establishment fee for extraction plant for building minerals (Stone and gravel) based on area of operation (15m X 15m) or part of | 4,500,000.00
(xxii) | Forest management fees for conducting mining activities (building minerals) in a forest reserve based on area of operation per year per ha or part of | 1,000,000.00
(xxiii) Forest management fees of shelter in a forest reserve for fishing per m2 or part of per year | 1000.00
(xxvii) To cultivate forest plantation land area for Poria cocos production per year per ha or part of | 1,300,000.00
Minister for Natural Resources and Tourism
